description: NOAA's marine forecast and tides for anywhere in Florida waters (Gulf, Atlantic, the Keys, Biscayne Bay, Lake Okeechobee): advisories, the next periods in NOAA's own words, and the nearest tide station. Give a position, or a ramp name from boat_ramps. Returns NOAA's own words; it does not say whether it's safe to go.

lat.description: Latitude of where the person is or will be

place.description: A boat ramp name or place_id from boat_ramps, instead of lat/lon

name: marine_forecast
title: NOAA marine forecast and tides
